title.zh: 卷七 梁本紀中第七 武帝下
title.raw: 卷七 梁本紀中第七 武帝下 Volume 7 :Liang Annals 2: Emperor Wu 2

sentences.zh: 梁本紀中第七

translations.literal: Liang Annals, Middle Fascicle Seven
translations.idiomatic: Liang Annals 2, Part Seven

sentences.zh: 普通元年春正月乙亥朔，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Putong, on yihai, the first day of the month, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the reign era was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the first year of Putong, on yihai, the first day of the first month, the court proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the reign era.

sentences.zh: 丙子，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以司徒臨川王宏為太尉、揚州刺史，以金紫光祿大夫王份為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On jimao, the Minister of Education Prince of Linchuan Hong was made Grand Commandant and Governor of Yang Province; the Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Girdle Wang Fen was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Minister of Education, Prince of Linchuan Hong, was appointed Grand Commandant and Governor of Yang Province; Wang Fen, Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Girdle, was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚子，扶南、高麗等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Funan, Goguryeo, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi envoys arrived from Funan, Goguryeo, and other states bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，以高麗王嗣子安為甯東將軍、高麗王。

translations.literal: In the second month on guichou, the Goguryeo king's heir An was made General Who Pacifies the East and King of Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guichou, the Goguryeo king's heir An was appointed General Who Pacifies the East and confirmed as King of Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 三月，滑國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the third month, Huaxia sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Huaxia sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，河南國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Henan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Henan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，江、淮、海並溢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on jimao, the Yangtze, Huai, and sea all overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jimao, the Yangtze, the Huai, and the sea all burst their bounds.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，有星晨見東方，光爛如火。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on yihai, a star appeared at dawn in the east, its light blazing like fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yihai, a star appeared at dawn in the east, blazing like fire.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏正光元年。

translations.literal: This year was the first year of Zhenguang in Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of Zhenguang in Wei.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛巳，祀南郊，詔置孤獨園以恤孤幼。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year on xinsi, the southern suburb was sacrificed to; an edict ordered the establishment of the Garden for the Solitary to succor orphans and the young.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year, on xinsi in the first month, the court sacrificed at the southern suburb and ordered the establishment of the Garden for the Solitary to care for orphans and the young.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大赦。

translations.literal: On wuzi, a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，祀明堂。

translations.literal: In the second month on xinchou, the Bright Hall was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinchou, the court sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，大雪，平地三尺。

translations.literal: In the third month on gengyin, heavy snow fell; three feet on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin, heavy snow piled three feet deep on level ground.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，改作南北郊。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on yimao, the southern and northern suburban altars were rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao, the southern and northern suburban altars were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔曰：「平秩東作，義不在南，前代因襲，有乖禮制。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict said: "Regulating the eastern labors and ranking them — the rite does not belong in the south; former ages followed precedent, contrary to ritual regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict declared: "The rite of ranking the eastern labors does not belong in the south; former ages followed precedent in violation of proper ritual.

sentences.zh: 可于震方，具茲千畝。

translations.literal: In the direction of Zhen one may prepare these thousand mu.
translations.idiomatic: Let the ceremonial field be prepared in the direction of Zhen, on these thousand mu.

sentences.zh: 」於是徙藉田於東郊外十五里。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the ceremonial plowing field was moved fifteen li east of the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: "Thereupon the ceremonial plowing field was moved fifteen li east of the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，琬琰殿火，延燒後宮屋三千間。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on jimao, the Wanyan Hall caught fire; the blaze spread and burned three thousand rooms of the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, the Wanyan Hall caught fire and the blaze spread through three thousand rooms of the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁巳，詔自今可停賀瑞。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on dingsi, an edict: from now on congratulations on auspicious omens may cease.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingsi, an edict ordered that congratulations on auspicious omens cease from that time forward.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，義州刺史文僧明以州歸魏。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on dingmao, Wen Sengming, Governor of Yizhou, surrendered the province to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingmao, Wen Sengming, Governor of Yizhou, surrendered his province to Wei.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，假大匠卿斐邃節，督眾軍侵魏。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on dingyou, the Acting Master of Works Fei Sui was given the tally and directed the armies in an incursion against Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou, Acting Master of Works Fei Sui received the tally and led the armies in an incursion against Wei.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，魏荊州刺史桓叔興帥眾降。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Huan Shuxing, Governor of Jing Province in Wei, led his forces in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Huan Shuxing, Wei's Governor of Jing Province, led his forces in surrender.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，始平郡石鼓村地自開成井，方六尺六寸，深三十二丈。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on dinghai, at Shigu Village in Shiping Commandery the ground opened of itself into a well, six chi six cun square, thirty-two zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dinghai, the ground at Shigu Village in Shiping Commandery opened of itself into a well six chi six cun square and thirty-two zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，百濟、新羅國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Baekje and Silla each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter Baekje and Silla each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，以鎮東大將軍百濟王餘隆為甯東大將軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on wuchen, Yu Long, King of Baekje and General Who Guards the East, was made Grand General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, Yu Long, King of Baekje and General Who Guards the East, was promoted to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚子，以吳郡太守王暕為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year on gengzi, Wang Yan, Administrator of Wu Commandery, was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year, on gengzi in the first month, Wang Yan, Administrator of Wu Commandery, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，都下地震。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the capital shook with an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，巴陵王蕭屏薨。

translations.literal: In the third month on yimao, Prince of Baling Xiao Ping died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yimao, Prince of Baling Xiao Ping died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，汝陰王劉端薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on dingmao, Prince of Ruyin Liu Duan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingmao, Prince of Ruyin Liu Duan died.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰朔，日有蝕之，既。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on renchen, the first day of the month, the sun was eclipsed; it was total.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renchen, the first day of the month, there was a total solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，大赦。

translations.literal: On guisi, a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 詔公卿百僚各上封事，連率郡國舉賢良、方正、直言之士。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the high ministers and all officials each to submit sealed memorials; the regional inspectors and commandery and state heads to recommend men of worth, integrity, and forthright speech.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered high ministers and all officials to submit sealed memorials, and regional inspectors and commandery and state heads to recommend men of worth, integrity, and forthright speech.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲子，婆利、白題國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn on jiazi, Poli and Baidi each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn Poli and Baidi each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲午，開府儀同三司始興王憺薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter on jiawu, Prince of Shixing Dan, with the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiawu, Prince of Shixing Dan, bearing the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies, died.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月辛卯，祀南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year on xinmao, the southern suburb was sacrificed to; a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on xinmao in the first month, the court sacrificed at the southern suburb and declared a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祀明堂。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Bright Hall was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the court sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，耕藉田，孝弟力田賜爵一級，豫耕之司，克日勞酒。

translations.literal: In the second month on yihai, the ceremonial field was plowed; filial sons, obedient younger brothers, and strong farmers were granted one rank of nobility; the officials who prepared the plowing were, on the appointed day, rewarded with wine.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yihai, the Emperor plowed the ceremonial field; filial sons, obedient younger brothers, and strong farmers were granted one rank of nobility, and the officials who prepared the plowing were rewarded with wine on the appointed day.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，以中衛將軍袁昂為尚書令，即本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on gengwu, Yuan Ang, General of the Central Guard, was made Director of the Secretariat, and with his existing title given the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengwu, Yuan Ang, General of the Central Guard, was appointed Director of the Secretariat and, retaining his existing title, granted the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on guiwei, the first day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，尚書左僕射王暕卒。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Wang Yan, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Wang Yan, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，用給事中王子雲議，始鑄鐵錢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on wuwu, following the proposal of Attendant Wang Ziyun, iron cash was first cast.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuwu, following the proposal of Attendant Wang Ziyun, the court began casting iron cash.

sentences.zh: 狼牙修國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Langyaxiu sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Langyaxiu sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年夏六月乙酉，龍鬥于曲阿王陂，因西行至建陵城，所經樹木倒折，開地數十丈。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer of the fifth year on yiyou, dragons fought at Wang Pond in Qu'e; then going west to Jiancheng, the trees along the way were snapped and broken, and the ground opened for several tens of zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer of the fifth year, on yiyou, dragons fought at Wang Pond in Qu'e, then moved west toward Jiancheng; trees along the way were snapped and the ground opened for tens of zhang.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以員外散騎常侍元樹為平北將軍、北青兗二州刺史，率眾侵魏。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Yuan Shu, Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, was made General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of the two provinces of Northern Qing and Yan, and led forces in an incursion against Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Yuan Shu, Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Northern Qing and Yan provinces, and led forces in an incursion against Wei.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛亥，祀南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year on xinhai, the southern suburb was sacrificed to; a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the sixth year, on xinhai in the first month, the court sacrificed at the southern suburb and declared a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚申，魏徐州刺史元法僧以彭城來降。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Yuan Faseng, Governor of Xu Province in Wei, came in surrender with Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Yuan Faseng, Wei's Governor of Xu Province, surrendered Pengcheng to Liang.

sentences.zh: 自去歲以來，北侵諸軍，所在克獲。

translations.literal: Since the previous year, the northern incursion armies wherever they went achieved capture and victory.
translations.idiomatic: Since the previous year the northern incursion armies had met with success wherever they marched.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以元法僧為司空，封始安郡王。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Yuan Faseng was made Minister of Works and enfeoffed as Prince of Shi'an Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Yuan Faseng was appointed Minister of Works and enfeoffed as Prince of Shi'an Commandery.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，改封法僧為宋王。

translations.literal: In the second month on xinsi, Faseng's enfeoffment was changed to Prince of Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinsi, Faseng's enfeoffment was changed to Prince of Song.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，賜新附人長復除，詿誤罪失，一無所問。

translations.literal: In the third month on bingwu, newly submitted people were granted long-term exemption from corvée and taxes; errors and offenses in registration were not questioned at all.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingwu, newly submitted people were granted long-term exemption from corvée and taxes, and errors in registration were not prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 夏五月己酉，修宿預堰，又修曹公堰于濟陰。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer on jiyou, the Suyu dyke was repaired, and the Cao Gong dyke was also repaired in Jiyin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on jiyou, the Suyu dyke was repaired, and the Cao Gong dyke was repaired in Jiyin as well.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣中護軍夏侯亶督壽陽諸軍侵魏。

translations.literal: On renzi, Xiahou Dan, General of the Central Guard, was dispatched to direct the Shouyang armies in an incursion against Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Xiahou Dan, General of the Central Guard, was dispatched to direct the Shouyang armies in an incursion against Wei.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，豫章王綜奔魏，魏復據彭城。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on gengchen, Prince of Yuzhang Zong fled to Wei; Wei again held Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengchen, Prince of Yuzhang Zong fled to Wei, and Wei again seized Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，大赦。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on renxu, a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renxu, a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月壬辰，都下地震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter on renchen, the capital shook with an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on renchen, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏孝昌元年。

translations.literal: This year was the first year of Xiaochang in Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of Xiaochang in Wei.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月辛丑朔，赦死罪以下。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the seventh year on xinchou, the first day of the month, those guilty of capital crimes and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the seventh year, on xinchou, the first day of the first month, those guilty of capital crimes and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，太尉臨川王宏薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on yiyou, Grand Commandant Prince of Linchuan Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou, Grand Commandant Prince of Linchuan Hong died.

sentences.zh: 南州津改置校尉，增加奉秩。

translations.literal: At the ferry crossings of the southern provinces, commandants were newly established and stipends increased.
translations.idiomatic: At the ferry crossings of the southern provinces commandants were newly established and stipends increased.

sentences.zh: 詔在位群臣，各舉所知，凡是清吏，咸使薦聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the ministers in office, each to recommend those he knew; all upright officials were to be recommended and reported.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered ministers in office each to recommend those they knew, and all upright officials were to be brought to the court's attention.

sentences.zh: 秋九月己酉，荊州刺史鄱陽王恢薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn on jiyou, Prince of Poyang Hui, Governor of Jing Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on jiyou, Prince of Poyang Hui, Governor of Jing Province, died.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月庚辰，丁貴嬪薨，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter on gengchen, Noble Consort Ding died; a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on gengchen, Noble Consort Ding died, and a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河南、高麗、林邑、滑國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: This year, Henan, Goguryeo, Linyi, and Huaxia all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Henan, Goguryeo, Linyi, and Huaxia all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 大通元年春正月乙丑，以尚書右僕射徐勉為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Datong on yichou, Xu Mian, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the first year of Datong, on yichou in the first month, Xu Mian, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 詔百官奉祿，自今可長給見錢。

translations.literal: An edict: the salaries of the hundred officials, from now on may be paid long-term in cash.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that from then on the salaries of all officials be paid regularly in cash.

sentences.zh: 辛未，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the southern suburb was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the court sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 詔流亡者聽復宅業，蠲役五年，尤貧家勿收今年三調，孝弟力田賜爵一級。

translations.literal: An edict: exiles were permitted to return to their homes and estates; corvée was remitted for five years; the poorest households were not to be charged this year's three levies; filial sons, obedient younger brothers, and strong farmers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: An edict permitted exiles to return to their homes and estates, remitted corvée for five years, exempted the poorest households from this year's three levies, and granted one rank of nobility to filial sons, obedient younger brothers, and strong farmers.

sentences.zh: 是月，司州刺史夏侯夔進軍三關，所至皆克。

translations.literal: This month, Xiahou Kui, Governor of Si Province, advanced against the Three Passes; wherever he arrived he conquered.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiahou Kui, Governor of Si Province, advanced against the Three Passes and conquered wherever he marched.

sentences.zh: 初，帝創同泰寺，至是開大通門以對寺之南門，取反語以協同泰。

translations.literal: Earlier the Emperor had founded Tongtai Temple; at this time the Datong Gate was opened facing the temple's south gate, taking the reversed phrase to harmonize with Tongtai.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Emperor had founded Tongtai Temple; now he opened the Datong Gate facing the temple's south gate, taking a reversed phrase to echo the name Tongtai.

sentences.zh: 自是晨夕講義，多由此門。

translations.literal: From this time morning and evening lectures mostly passed through this gate.
translations.idiomatic: From then on morning and evening lectures mostly passed through this gate.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，幸寺捨身。

translations.literal: In the third month on xinwei, the Emperor visited the temple and offered his body.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei, the Emperor visited the temple and offered his body to the sangha.

sentences.zh: 甲戌還宮，大赦，改元大通，以符寺及門名。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he returned to the palace; a great amnesty; the era was changed to Datong, to accord with the temple and gate names.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he returned to the palace, declared a general amnesty, and changed the reign era to Datong to accord with the temple and gate names.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙寅，成景雋克魏臨潼、竹邑。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer on bingyin, Cheng Jingjun captured Lintong and Zhuyi in Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on bingyin, Cheng Jingjun captured Lintong and Zhuyi from Wei.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚戌，魏東豫州刺史元慶和以渦陽內屬。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on gengxu, Yuan Qinghe, Governor of Eastern Yuzhou in Wei, submitted Guoyang to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengxu, Yuan Qinghe, Wei's Governor of Eastern Yuzhou, submitted Guoyang to Liang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，曲赦東豫州。

translations.literal: On jiayin, a partial amnesty for Eastern Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin a partial amnesty was declared for Eastern Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，以中護軍蕭藻為都督侵魏，鎮于渦陽。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on dingmao, Xiao Zao, General of the Central Guard, was made Commander-in-Chief for the incursion against Wei and garrisoned at Guoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingmao, Xiao Zao, General of the Central Guard, was appointed commander for the incursion against Wei and garrisoned at Guoyang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，林邑、師子、高麗等國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: This year, Linyi, Shizi, Goguryeo, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Linyi, Shizi, Goguryeo, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙酉，蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year on yiyou, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year, on yiyou in the first month, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月，築寒山堰。

translations.literal: In the second month, the Hanshan dyke was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Hanshan dyke was built.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，魏孝明皇帝崩。

translations.literal: On guichou, Emperor Xiaoming of Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Emperor Xiaoming of Wei died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，魏尒朱榮推奉孝莊帝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on wuxu, Erzhu Rong of Wei installed Emperor Xiaozhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuxu, Erzhu Rong of Wei installed Emperor Xiaozhuang.

sentences.zh: 庚子，榮殺幼主及太后胡氏。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Rong killed the young ruler and Empress Dowager Hu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Rong killed the young ruler and Empress Dowager Hu.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，魏郢州刺史元願達以義陽降，封願達為樂平王。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Yuan Yuanda, Governor of Ying Province in Wei, surrendered Yiyang; Yuanda was enfeoffed as Prince of Leping.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Yuan Yuanda, Wei's Governor of Ying Province, surrendered Yiyang and was enfeoffed as Prince of Leping.

sentences.zh: 是時魏大亂，其北海王顥、臨淮王彧、汝南王悅並來奔。

translations.literal: At this time Wei was in great disorder; its Prince of Beihai Hao, Prince of Huaiyin Yu, and Prince of Runan Yue all came in flight.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Wei was in great disorder; Prince of Beihai Hao, Prince of Huaiyin Yu, and Prince of Runan Yue all fled to Liang.

sentences.zh: 北青州刺史元雋、南荊州刺史李志皆以地降。

translations.literal: Yuan Jun, Governor of Northern Qing Province, and Li Zhi, Governor of Southern Jing Province, both surrendered their territories.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Jun, Governor of Northern Qing Province, and Li Zhi, Governor of Southern Jing Province, both surrendered their territories.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，以魏北海王顥主魏，遣東宮直閣將軍陳慶之衛送還北。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on dinghai, Prince of Beihai Hao of Wei was set up to rule Wei; the Eastern Palace Direct Attendant Chen Qingzhi was dispatched to escort him back north.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dinghai, Prince of Beihai Hao of Wei was installed to rule Wei, and Eastern Palace Direct Attendant Chen Qingzhi was dispatched to escort him back north.

sentences.zh: 魏豫州刺史鄧獻以地降。

translations.literal: Deng Xian, Governor of Yuzhou in Wei, surrendered his territory.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Xian, Wei's Governor of Yuzhou, surrendered his territory.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏武泰元年，尋改為建義，又改曰永安。

translations.literal: This year was the first year of Wutai in Wei; soon it was changed to Jianyi, then again to Yongan.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of Wutai in Wei; soon it was changed to Jianyi, then again to Yongan.

sentences.zh: 中大通元年春正月辛酉，祀南郊，大赦，賜孝悌力田爵一級。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Zhongdatong on xinyou, the southern suburb was sacrificed to; a great amnesty; filial sons, obedient younger brothers, and strong farmers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the first year of Zhongdatong, on xinyou in the first month, the court sacrificed at the southern suburb, declared a general amnesty, and granted one rank of nobility to filial sons, obedient younger brothers, and strong farmers.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，祀明堂。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the Bright Hall was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the court sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳，陳慶之攻拔魏梁城，進屠考城，禽魏濟陰王暉業。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on guisi, Chen Qingzhi attacked and took Liangcheng in Wei, advanced to sack and slaughter Kaocheng, and captured Prince of Jiyin Huiye of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guisi, Chen Qingzhi attacked and took Liangcheng in Wei, advanced to sack Kaocheng, and captured Prince of Jiyin Huiye of Wei.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，進克虎牢，魏孝莊帝出居河北。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on guiyou, he advanced and captured Hulao; Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei went out to dwell north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiyou, he advanced and captured Hulao; Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei withdrew north of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，元顥入京師，僭號建武。

translations.literal: On yihai, Yuan Hao entered the capital and usurped the era name Jianwu.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Yuan Hao entered the capital and usurped the era name Jianwu.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，以永興公主疾篤故，大赦，公主志也。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on renwu, because Princess Yongxing was gravely ill, a great amnesty — the Princess's wish.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renwu, because Princess Yongxing was gravely ill, a general amnesty was declared at the Princess's wish.

sentences.zh: 是月，都下疫甚，帝於重雲殿為百姓設救苦齋，以身為禱。

translations.literal: This month, plague in the capital was severe; the Emperor at the Chongyun Hall set up a salvation-from-suffering fast for the people and offered himself in prayer.
translations.idiomatic: That month plague in the capital was severe; at the Chongyun Hall the Emperor set up a salvation-from-suffering fast for the people and offered himself in prayer.

sentences.zh: 閏月，護軍將軍南康王績薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, Prince of Nankang Ji, General Who Protects the Army, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Prince of Nankang Ji, General Who Protects the Army, died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，魏將尒朱榮攻殺元顥，京師反正。

translations.literal: On jimao, the Wei general Erzhu Rong attacked and killed Yuan Hao; the capital returned to the right.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Wei general Erzhu Rong attacked and killed Yuan Hao, and the capital returned to order.

sentences.zh: 秋九月辛巳，朱雀航華表災。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn on xinsi, the ornamental column at the Zhuque Bridge was destroyed by fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on xinsi, the ornamental column at the Zhuque Bridge was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，幸同泰寺，設四部無遮大會。

translations.literal: On guisi, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple and set up the Fourfold Assembly Unrestricted Great Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple and convened the Fourfold Assembly Unrestricted Great Assembly.

sentences.zh: 上釋御服，披法衣，行清淨大舍，以便省為房，素床瓦器，乘小車，私人執役。

translations.literal: The sovereign cast off imperial robes, donned dharma robes, and undertook the great pure offering of his body; he took the privy chamber as his room, with plain bed and earthenware vessels, riding a small carriage, with private persons performing service.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign cast off imperial robes and donned dharma robes, undertaking the great pure offering of his body; he made the privy chamber his room, with a plain bed and earthenware vessels, riding a small carriage while private persons served him.

sentences.zh: 甲午，升講堂法坐，為四部大眾開涅盤經題。

translations.literal: On jiawu, he ascended the dharma seat in the lecture hall and opened the Nirvana Sutra for the fourfold assembly.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he ascended the dharma seat in the lecture hall and opened the Nirvana Sutra for the fourfold assembly.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，群臣以錢一億萬奉贖皇帝菩薩大舍，僧眾默許。

translations.literal: On guimao, the ministers with one hundred million in cash offered to ransom the Emperor's bodhisattva great offering; the monastic assembly silently assented.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the ministers offered one hundred million in cash to ransom the Emperor's bodhisattva great offering; the monastic assembly silently assented.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，百辟詣寺東門奉表，請還臨宸極，三請乃許。

translations.literal: On yisi, the hundred ministers went to the temple's east gate with a memorial, requesting return to the imperial throne; after three requests he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the hundred ministers went to the temple's east gate with a memorial requesting his return to the imperial throne; after three requests he assented.

sentences.zh: 帝三答書，前後並稱頓首。

translations.literal: The Emperor answered with three letters; each in front and back called himself prostrate.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor answered with three letters, each signed with a prostration.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，又設四部無遮大會，道俗五萬餘人。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on jiyou, the Fourfold Assembly Unrestricted Great Assembly was again set up; monks and laity numbered more than fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiyou, the Fourfold Assembly Unrestricted Great Assembly was convened again; monks and laity numbered more than fifty thousand.

sentences.zh: 會畢，帝御金輅還宮，禦太極殿，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: When the assembly ended, the Emperor rode the golden carriage back to the palace, ascended the Hall of Supreme Polarity, and proclaimed a great amnesty and changed the era.
translations.idiomatic: When the assembly ended the Emperor rode the golden carriage back to the palace, ascended the Hall of Supreme Polarity, declared a general amnesty, and changed the reign era.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，魏巴州刺史嚴始欣以城降。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on wuzi, Yan Shixin, Governor of Ba Province in Wei, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuzi, Yan Shixin, Wei's Governor of Ba Province, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 是歲，盤盤、蠕蠕國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: This year, Panpan and Rouran each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Panpan and Rouran each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年夏四月癸丑，幸同泰寺，設平等會。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the second year on guichou, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple and set up the Assembly of Equality.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer of the second year, on guichou, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple and convened the Assembly of Equality.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大雨雹。

translations.literal: On gengshen, heavy hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen heavy hail fell.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，遣魏汝南王悅還北主魏。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on dingsi, Prince of Runan Yue of Wei was sent back north to rule Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingsi, Prince of Runan Yue of Wei was sent back north to rule Wei.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以魏尚書左僕射范遵為司州牧，隨悅北侵。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Fan Zun, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat in Wei, was made Governor of Si Province and followed Yue north in incursion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Fan Zun, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat in Wei, was appointed Governor of Si Province and followed Yue north on campaign.

sentences.zh: 是月，林邑、扶南國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: This month, Linyi and Funan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That month Linyi and Funan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋八月庚戌，幸德陽堂，祖魏主元悅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn on gengxu, the Emperor visited the Deyang Hall and performed the farewell rites for the Wei ruler Yuan Yue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on gengxu, the Emperor visited the Deyang Hall and performed farewell rites for the Wei ruler Yuan Yue.

sentences.zh: 山賊寇會稽郡縣。

translations.literal: Mountain bandits raided the commanderies and counties of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain bandits raided the commanderies and counties of Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，假超武將軍湛海珍節以討之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on renwu, Acting General of Superlative Martiality Zhan Haizhen was given the tally to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renwu, Acting General of Superlative Martiality Zhan Haizhen received the tally to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏莊帝殺其權臣尒朱榮，其党奉魏長廣王曄為主而殺孝莊帝，年號建明。

translations.literal: This year, Emperor Zhuang of Wei killed his powerful minister Erzhu Rong; his faction installed Prince of Changguang Ye of Wei as ruler and killed Emperor Xiaozhuang; the era name was Jianming.
translations.idiomatic: That year Emperor Zhuang of Wei killed his powerful minister Erzhu Rong; his faction installed Prince of Changguang Ye as ruler and killed Emperor Xiaozhuang, under the era name Jianming.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛巳，祀南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year on xinsi, the southern suburb was sacrificed to; a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year, on xinsi in the first month, the court sacrificed at the southern suburb and declared a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以魏尚書僕射鄭先護為征北大將軍。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Zheng Xianhu, Vice Director of the Secretariat in Wei, was made Grand General Who Conquers the North.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zheng Xianhu, Vice Director of the Secretariat in Wei, was appointed Grand General Who Conquers the North.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，祀明堂。

translations.literal: In the second month on xinchou, the Bright Hall was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinchou, the court sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，皇太子統薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on yisi, Crown Prince Tong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yisi, Crown Prince Tong died.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，立昭明太子子華容公歡為豫章郡王，枝江公譽為河東郡王，曲江公察為岳陽郡王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on guichou, Huan, Duke of Huarong and son of Crown Prince Zhaoming, was established as Prince of Yuzhang; Yu, Duke of Zhijiang, as Prince of Hedong; Cha, Duke of Qujiang, as Prince of Yueyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guichou, Huan, Duke of Huarong and son of Crown Prince Zhaoming, was established as Prince of Yuzhang; Yu, Duke of Zhijiang, as Prince of Hedong; and Cha, Duke of Qujiang, as Prince of Yueyang.

sentences.zh: 是月，丹丹國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: This month, Danan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That month Danan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，立晉安王綱為皇太子，大赦。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on yihai, Prince of Jin'an Gang was established as Crown Prince; a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yihai, Prince of Jin'an Gang was established as Crown Prince and a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 賜為父後者，及出處忠孝、文武清勤，並爵一級。

translations.literal: Those who had become heirs for their fathers, and those outstanding in loyalty and filial piety, civil and martial service, and clean diligence, were all granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had become heirs for their fathers, and those outstanding in loyalty, filial piety, civil and martial service, and clean diligence, were all granted one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔宗戚有服屬者，並賜湯沐食，鄉亭侯各隨遠近以為差次。

translations.literal: On gengyin, an edict: clansmen within the mourning relationship were all granted bath-and-rest fiefs; Marquises of township and hamlet each according to distance received graded allotments.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin an edict granted bath-and-rest fiefs to clansmen within the mourning relationship; Marquises of township and hamlet received graded allotments according to distance.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以吏部尚書何敬容為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On renchen, He Jingrong, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen He Jingrong, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九月，狼牙修國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Langyaxiu sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Langyaxiu sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是秋，吳興生野稻，饑者賴焉。

translations.literal: This autumn, wild rice grew in Wuxing; the hungry relied on it.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn wild rice grew in Wuxing, and the hungry relied on it.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，上幸同泰寺，升法坐，為四部眾說涅盤經，迄於乙卯。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on jiyou, the sovereign visited Tongtai Temple, ascended the dharma seat, and expounded the Nirvana Sutra for the fourfold assembly, until yimao.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiyou, the sovereign visited Tongtai Temple, ascended the dharma seat, and expounded the Nirvana Sutra for the fourfold assembly until yimao.

sentences.zh: 前樂山縣侯蕭正則有罪流徙，至是招誘亡命，欲寇廣州，在所討平之。

translations.literal: Former Marquis of Leshan Xiao Zhengze, guilty and exiled, at this time gathered runaways and intended to raid Guangzhou; wherever he went he was suppressed and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Former Marquis of Leshan Xiao Zhengze, guilty and exiled, now gathered runaways and intended to raid Guangzhou; he was suppressed wherever he went.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，上幸同泰寺，升法座，為四部眾說般若經，迄于十二月辛丑。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on yiwei, the sovereign visited Tongtai Temple, ascended the dharma seat, and expounded the Prajna Sutra for the fourfold assembly, until xinchou in the twelfth month.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiwei, the sovereign visited Tongtai Temple, ascended the dharma seat, and expounded the Prajna Sutra for the fourfold assembly until xinchou in the twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏尒朱兆又廢其主曄而奉節閔皇帝，改建明二年為普泰元年。

translations.literal: This year, Erzhu Zhao of Wei again deposed his ruler Ye and installed Emperor Jiemin; the second year of Jianming was changed to the first year of Putai.
translations.idiomatic: That year Erzhu Zhao of Wei again deposed his ruler Ye and installed Emperor Jiemin, changing the second year of Jianming to the first year of Putai.

sentences.zh: 又魏勃海王高歡舉兵信都，別奉勃海太守朗為主，改普泰元年為中興。

translations.literal: Also Prince of Bohai Gao Huan of Wei raised troops at Xindu and separately installed Lang, Administrator of Bohai, as ruler; the first year of Putai was changed to Zhongxing.
translations.idiomatic: Also Prince of Bohai Gao Huan of Wei raised troops at Xindu and separately installed Lang, Administrator of Bohai, as ruler, changing the first year of Putai to Zhongxing.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙寅，以開府儀同三司南平王偉為大司馬，以司空宋王元法僧為太尉，以尚書令、開府儀同三司袁昂為司空。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year on bingyin, Prince of Nanping Wei, with the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies, was made Grand Marshal; Yuan Faseng, Minister of Works and Prince of Song, was made Grand Commandant; Yuan Ang, Director of the Secretariat with the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on bingyin in the first month, Prince of Nanping Wei, bearing the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies, was appointed Grand Marshal; Yuan Faseng, Minister of Works and Prince of Song, was made Grand Commandant; and Yuan Ang, Director of the Secretariat with the same insignia, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 立臨川靖惠王宏子正德為臨賀郡王。

translations.literal: Zhengde, son of Prince of Linchuan Jinghui Hong, was established as Prince of Linhe Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde, son of Prince of Linchuan Jinghui Hong, was established as Prince of Linhe Commandery.

sentences.zh: 庚午，立嫡皇孫大器為宣城郡王，位列諸王上。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the legitimate imperial grandson Daqi was established as Prince of Xuancheng Commandery, ranking above the other princes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the legitimate imperial grandson Daqi was established as Prince of Xuancheng Commandery, ranking above the other princes.

sentences.zh: 癸未，魏南兗州刺史劉世明以城降。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Liu Shiming, Governor of Southern Yan Province in Wei, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Liu Shiming, Wei's Governor of Southern Yan Province, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，以太尉元法僧還北主魏，以侍中元景隆為徐州刺史，封彭城郡王，通直常侍元景宗為青州刺史，封平昌郡王，隨法僧北侵。

translations.literal: In the second month on renyin, Grand Commandant Yuan Faseng was sent back north to rule Wei; Attendant Yuan Jinglong was made Governor of Xu Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Pengcheng Commandery; Attendant-in-Ordinary Yuan Jingzong was made Governor of Qing Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Pingchang Commandery; they followed Faseng north in incursion.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renyin, Grand Commandant Yuan Faseng was sent back north to rule Wei; Attendant Yuan Jinglong was appointed Governor of Xu Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Pengcheng Commandery; Attendant-in-Ordinary Yuan Jingzong was made Governor of Qing Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Pingchang Commandery; they followed Faseng north on campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，新除揚州刺史邵陵王綸有罪，免為庶人。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the newly appointed Governor of Yang Province Prince of Shaoling Lun, guilty, was demoted to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the newly appointed Governor of Yang Province, Prince of Shaoling Lun, was found guilty and demoted to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，侍中、領國子博士蕭子顯表置制旨孝經助教一人，生十人，專通帝所釋孝經義。

translations.literal: In the third month on gengwu, Attendant and Director of the Imperial Academy Xiao Zixian memorialized to establish one Assistant Instructor for the Imperially Composed Filial Piety Classic and ten students, devoted exclusively to the Emperor's exposition of the Filial Piety Classic.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengwu, Attendant and Director of the Imperial Academy Xiao Zixian memorialized to establish one Assistant Instructor for the Imperially Composed Filial Piety Classic and ten students devoted exclusively to the Emperor's exposition of that classic.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，盤盤國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Panpan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Panpan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，星隕如雨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on jiachen, stars fell like rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiachen, stars fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，加司空袁昂尚書令。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on yisi, Minister of Works Yuan Ang was additionally made Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yisi, Minister of Works Yuan Ang was additionally appointed Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，魏彭城王尒朱仲遠來奔，以為定洛將軍，封河南王，北侵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on bingzi, Prince of Pengcheng Erzhu Zhongyuan of Wei came in flight; he was made General Who Settles Luo and enfeoffed as Prince of Henan, and sent north in incursion.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingzi, Prince of Pengcheng Erzhu Zhongyuan of Wei fled to Liang; he was appointed General Who Settles Luo and enfeoffed as Prince of Henan, then sent north on campaign.

sentences.zh: 隨所克土，使自封建。

translations.literal: Wherever territory was captured, he was permitted to enfeoff himself.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever territory was captured he was permitted to enfeoff himself.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以太尉元法僧為郢州刺史、驃騎大將軍、開府同三司之儀。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Grand Commandant Yuan Faseng was made Governor of Ying Province, General of Agile Cavalry, and with the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Grand Commandant Yuan Faseng was appointed Governor of Ying Province and General of Agile Cavalry, with the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏相勃海王高歡平尒朱氏，廢節閔皇帝及自所奉勃海故王朗，而奉平陽王修，是為孝武皇帝。

translations.literal: This year, Chancellor Prince of Bohai Gao Huan of Wei pacified the Erzhu clan, deposed Emperor Jiemin and the former King Lang he himself had installed, and installed Prince of Pingyang Xiu — this is Emperor Xiaowu; the second year of Zhongxing was changed to Taichang, soon again to Yongxi.
translations.idiomatic: That year Chancellor Prince of Bohai Gao Huan of Wei pacified the Erzhu clan, deposed Emperor Jiemin and the former King Lang he had installed, and installed Prince of Pingyang Xiu as Emperor Xiaowu; the second year of Zhongxing was changed to Taichang, then soon to Yongxi.

sentences.zh: 改中興二年為太昌，尋又改為永熙元年。

translations.literal: The second year of Zhongxing was changed to Taichang; soon again to the first year of Yongxi.
translations.idiomatic: The second year of Zhongxing became Taichang, then soon the first year of Yongxi.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛卯，祀南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fifth year on xinmao, the southern suburb was sacrificed to; a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifth year, on xinmao in the first month, the court sacrificed at the southern suburb and declared a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 賜孝悌力田爵一級。

translations.literal: Filial sons, obedient younger brothers, and strong farmers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient younger brothers, and strong farmers were granted one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 先是一日丙夜，南郊令解滌之等到郊所履行，忽聞異香三隨風至。

translations.literal: Earlier, on the night before, when the Director of the Southern Suburb Xie Dizhi and others arrived at the suburban site and walked the grounds, they suddenly smelled a strange fragrance three times following the wind.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, on the night before, when Director of the Southern Suburb Xie Dizhi and others arrived at the suburban site and walked the grounds, they suddenly smelled a strange fragrance three times on the wind.

sentences.zh: 及將行事，奏樂迎神畢，有神光圓滿壇上，朱紫黃白雜色，食頃乃滅。

translations.literal: When the rites were about to be performed, after the music welcoming the spirits was played, a divine light, round and full, filled the altar — red, purple, yellow, and white mixed — and after the time of a meal it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were about to be performed and the music welcoming the spirits had finished, a round divine light filled the altar in red, purple, yellow, and white; after the time of a meal it vanished.

sentences.zh: 戊申，都下地震。

translations.literal: On wushen, the capital shook with an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己酉，長星見。

translations.literal: On jiyou, a long comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou a long comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祀明堂。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Bright Hall was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the court sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，幸同泰寺，設四部大會，升法坐，發金字般若經題，訖於己丑。

translations.literal: In the second month on guiwei, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple, set up the Fourfold Assembly, ascended the dharma seat, and opened the gold-letter Prajna Sutra, until jichou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiwei, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple, convened the Fourfold Assembly, ascended the dharma seat, and opened the gold-letter Prajna Sutra until jichou.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，大司馬南平王偉薨。

translations.literal: In the third month on bingchen, Grand Marshal Prince of Nanping Wei died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingchen, Grand Marshal Prince of Nanping Wei died.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊子，都下大水，御道通船。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer on wuzi, the capital flooded; boats passed on the imperial avenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on wuzi, the capital flooded so deeply that boats passed on the imperial avenue.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，魏建義城主蘭保殺東徐州刺史崔庠，以下邳降。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on jimao, Lan Bao, commander of Jianyi city, killed Cui Xiang, Governor of Eastern Xu Province, and surrendered Xiapi to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao, Lan Bao, commander of Jianyi city, killed Cui Xiang, Governor of Eastern Xu Province, and surrendered Xiapi to Liang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，以尚書右僕射何敬容為左僕射，以吏部尚書謝舉為右僕射。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on gengshen, He Jingrong, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made Left Vice Director; Xie Ju, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengshen, He Jingrong, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, was promoted to Left Vice Director; Xie Ju, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 是歲，河南、波斯、盤盤等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: This year, Henan, Persia, Panpan, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Henan, Persia, Panpan, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年春二月癸亥，耕藉田，大赦。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the sixth year on guihai, the ceremonial field was plowed; a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the sixth year, on guihai, the ceremonial field was plowed and a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 賜孝悌力田爵一級。

translations.literal: Filial sons, obedient younger brothers, and strong farmers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient younger brothers, and strong farmers were granted one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，以行河南王可遝振為西秦、河二州刺史，正封河南王。

translations.literal: In the third month on jihai, Keduo Zhen, Acting Prince of Henan, was made Governor of the two provinces of Western Qin and He, and formally enfeoffed as Prince of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jihai, Keduo Zhen, Acting Prince of Henan, was appointed Governor of Western Qin and He provinces and formally enfeoffed as Prince of Henan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，百濟國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Baekje sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Baekje sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，熒惑在南斗。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on dingmao, the Spark Star was in the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingmao, the Spark Star stood in the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，林邑國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on jiachen, Linyi sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Linyi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，以信武將軍元慶和為鎮北將軍，封魏王，率眾北侵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on dingmao, Yuan Qinghe, General of Trustworthy Martiality, was made General Who Pacifies the North and enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, and led forces north in incursion.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingmao, Yuan Qinghe, General of Trustworthy Martiality, was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, then led forces north on campaign.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月丙午，西南有雷聲二。

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month on bingwu, in the southwest there were two claps of thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month, on bingwu, two claps of thunder sounded in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 是歲，魏孝武帝迫于其相高歡，出居關中。

translations.literal: This year, Emperor Xiaowu of Wei, pressed by his chancellor Gao Huan, went out to dwell in Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: That year Emperor Xiaowu of Wei, pressed by his chancellor Gao Huan, withdrew to Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 歡又別奉清河王世子善見為主，是為孝靜帝。

translations.literal: Huan again separately installed the heir of Prince of Qinghe Shan as ruler — this is Emperor Xiaojing.
translations.idiomatic: Huan again separately installed the heir of Prince of Qinghe Shan as ruler — Emperor Xiaojing.

sentences.zh: 改永熙三年為天平元年。

translations.literal: The third year of Yongxi was changed to the first year of Tianping.
translations.idiomatic: The third year of Yongxi was changed to the first year of Tianping.

sentences.zh: 魏於是始分為兩。

translations.literal: Wei from this time began to be divided in two.
translations.idiomatic: From this time Wei was divided in two.

sentences.zh: 孝武既至關中，又與丞相宇文泰不平，未幾，遇鴆而崩。

translations.literal: After Xiaowu reached Guanzhong, he was again at odds with Chancellor Yuwen Tai; before long he met death by poisoned wine.
translations.idiomatic: After Xiaowu reached Guanzhong he fell out with Chancellor Yuwen Tai; before long he died by poisoned wine.

sentences.zh: 大同元年春正月戊申朔，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Datong on wushen, the first day of the month, a great amnesty; the era was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the first year of Datong, on wushen, the first day of the first month, the court declared a general amnesty and changed the reign era.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，祀明堂。

translations.literal: In the second month on xinsi, the Bright Hall was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinsi, the court sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，耕藉田。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the ceremonial field was plowed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the ceremonial field was plowed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，高麗、丹丹國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Goguryeo and Danan each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Goguryeo and Danan each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，幸同泰寺，設無遮大會。

translations.literal: In the third month on bingyin, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple and set up the Unrestricted Great Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingyin, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple and convened the Unrestricted Great Assembly.

sentences.zh: 辛未，滑國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Huaxia sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Huaxia sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，波斯國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on gengzi, Persia sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Persia sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，幸同泰寺，鑄十方銀像，並設無礙會。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple, cast ten silver images of the ten directions, and set up the Unobstructed Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple, cast ten silver images of the ten directions, and convened the Unobstructed Assembly.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，扶南國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on xinmao, Funan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Funan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，雨黃塵如雪。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, yellow dust rained like snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter yellow dust fell like snow.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，北梁州刺史蘭欽攻漢中，魏梁州刺史元羅降。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on renxu, Lan Qin, Governor of Northern Liang Province, attacked Hanzhong; Yuan Luo, Governor of Liang Province in Wei, surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renxu, Lan Qin, Governor of Northern Liang Province, attacked Hanzhong; Yuan Luo, Wei's Governor of Liang Province, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，復梁州。

translations.literal: On guihai, Liang Province was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Liang Province was restored.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西魏文皇帝大統元年。

translations.literal: This year was the first year of Datong of Emperor Wen of Western Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of Datong of Emperor Wen of Western Wei.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月乙亥，耕藉田。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the second year on yihai, the ceremonial field was plowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the second year, on yihai, the ceremonial field was plowed.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，詔求讜言，及令文武在位舉士。

translations.literal: In the third month on gengshen, an edict sought forthright speech, and ordered civil and military officials in office to recommend scholars.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengshen, an edict sought forthright speech and ordered civil and military officials in office to recommend scholars.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，帝幸同泰寺，設平等法會。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple and set up the Assembly of Equality.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple and convened the Assembly of Equality.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，以開府同三司之儀元法僧為太尉。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on yiwei, Yuan Faseng was made Grand Commandant with the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yiwei, Yuan Faseng was appointed Grand Commandant with the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，以魏梁州刺史元羅為青、冀二州刺史，封東郡王。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on guimao, Yuan Luo, Governor of Liang Province in Wei, was made Governor of the two provinces of Qing and Ji and enfeoffed as Prince of Dongjun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guimao, Yuan Luo, Wei's Governor of Liang Province, was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces and enfeoffed as Prince of Dongjun.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，詔郊明堂陵廟等令，改視散騎侍郎。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on dinghai, an edict: the directors of suburban, Bright Hall, and tomb rites were changed to the rank of Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dinghai, an edict changed the directors of suburban, Bright Hall, and tomb rites to the rank of Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary.

sentences.zh: 秋九月辛亥，幸同泰寺，設四部無礙法會。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn on xinhai, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple and set up the Fourfold Unobstructed Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on xinhai, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple and convened the Fourfold Unobstructed Assembly.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥，詔大舉北侵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on yihai, an edict ordered a great northern incursion.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yihai, an edict ordered a great northern incursion.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸同泰寺，設無礙大會。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple and set up the Unrestricted Great Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple and convened the Unrestricted Great Assembly.

sentences.zh: 十一月，雨黃塵如雪，攬之盈掬。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, yellow dust rained like snow; gathered, it filled cupped hands.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month yellow dust fell like snow; gathered in cupped hands it filled the palms.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔北侵眾軍班師。

translations.literal: On jihai, an edict ordered the northern incursion armies to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai an edict ordered the northern incursion armies to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，都下地震，生白毛，長二尺。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the capital shook with an earthquake; white hair grew, two chi long.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the capital was shaken by an earthquake; white hair grew two chi long from the ground.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，與東魏通和。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on renshen, peace was made with Eastern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renshen, peace was made with Eastern Wei.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛丑，祀南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year on xinchou, the southern suburb was sacrificed to; a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year, on xinchou in the first month, the court sacrificed at the southern suburb and declared a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 賜孝悌力田爵一級。

translations.literal: Filial sons, obedient younger brothers, and strong farmers were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient younger brothers, and strong farmers were granted one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 是夜，朱雀門災。

translations.literal: That night, the Zhuque Gate was destroyed by fire.
translations.idiomatic: That night the Zhuque Gate was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，雨灰，黃色。

translations.literal: On renyin, ash rained; yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin ash fell from the sky, yellow in color.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥。

translations.literal: In the second month on dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dinghai,

sentences.zh: 耕藉田。

translations.literal: The ceremonial field was plowed.
translations.idiomatic: the ceremonial field was plowed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以護軍將軍蕭藻為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On guisi, Xiao Zao, General Who Protects the Army, was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Xiao Zao, General Who Protects the Army, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，立昭明太子子謷為武昌郡王，臨為義陽郡王。

translations.literal: In the third month on wuxu, Ao, son of Crown Prince Zhaoming, was established as Prince of Wuchang Commandery; Lin as Prince of Yiyang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuxu, Ao, son of Crown Prince Zhaoming, was established as Prince of Wuchang Commandery and Lin as Prince of Yiyang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸未，幸同泰寺，鑄十方金銅像，設無礙法會。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer on guiwei, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple, cast ten gold and bronze images of the ten directions, and set up the Unobstructed Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on guiwei, the Emperor visited Tongtai Temple, cast ten gold and bronze images of the ten directions, and convened the Unobstructed Assembly.

sentences.zh: 六月，青州朐山隕霜。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, frost fell on Qushan in Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month frost fell on Qushan in Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，青州雪，害苗稼。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, snow fell in Qing Province and harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn snow fell in Qing Province and harmed the crops.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，東魏人來聘。

translations.literal: On guimao, men of Eastern Wei came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao envoys from Eastern Wei arrived on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 己酉，義陽王臨薨。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Prince of Yiyang Lin died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Prince of Yiyang Lin died.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，幸阿育王寺，設無礙法喜食，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on xinmao, the Emperor visited the Ashoka Temple, set up the Unobstructed Dharma Joy feast, and proclaimed a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao, the Emperor visited the Ashoka Temple, set up the Unobstructed Dharma Joy feast, and declared a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 九月，使兼散騎常侍張皋聘於東魏。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Acting Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Zhang Gao was sent on a friendly mission to Eastern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Acting Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Zhang Gao was sent on a friendly mission to Eastern Wei.

sentences.zh: 閏九月甲子，侍中、太尉元法僧薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary ninth month on jiazi, Attendant and Grand Commandant Yuan Faseng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month, on jiazi, Attendant and Grand Commandant Yuan Faseng died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，都下地震。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on bingchen, the capital shook with an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingchen, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 是歲饑。

translations.literal: This year there was famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year famine struck.

sentences.zh: 四年春二月己亥，耕藉田。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the fourth year on jihai, the ceremonial field was plowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the fourth year, on jihai, the ceremonial field was plowed.

sentences.zh: 三月，河南、蠕蠕國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the third month, Henan and Rouran each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Henan and Rouran each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲戌，東魏人來聘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer on jiaxu, men of Eastern Wei came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer envoys from Eastern Wei arrived on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on xinchou, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinchou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸亥，詔以東冶徒李胤之降象牙如來真形，大赦。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on guihai, an edict: because convict Li Yinzhi of the Eastern Foundry submitted an ivory image of the Tathagata in true form, a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guihai, an edict declared a general amnesty because Li Yinzhi, a convict of the Eastern Foundry, had submitted an ivory image of the Tathagata in true form.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，使兼散騎常侍劉孝儀聘於東魏。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Acting Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Xiaoyi was sent on a friendly mission to Eastern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Acting Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Xiaoyi was sent on a friendly mission to Eastern Wei.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，詔南兗等十二州，既經饑饉，曲赦逋租宿責，勿收今年三調。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on jiachen, an edict: the twelve provinces including Southern Yan, having suffered famine, received a partial amnesty for overdue rents and old debts; this year's three levies were not collected.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiachen, an edict granted a partial amnesty to the twelve provinces including Southern Yan, which had suffered famine, remitting overdue rents and old debts and exempting them from this year's three levies.

sentences.zh: 九月，閱武于樂游苑。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, military review was held at the Leyou Park.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month a military review was held at the Leyou Park.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙卯，以護軍將軍廬陵王續為驃騎將軍，安右將軍、尚書左僕射蕭藻為中衛將軍，並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fifth year on yimao, Prince of Luling Xu, General Who Protects the Army, was made General of Agile Cavalry; Xiao Zao, General Who Stabilizes the Right and Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made General of the Central Guard — both with the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on yimao, Prince of Luling Xu, General Who Protects the Army, was promoted to General of Agile Cavalry; Xiao Zao, General Who Stabilizes the Right and Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, was made General of the Central Guard — both with the insignia of Opening an Office and Peer of the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 中權將軍、丹陽尹何敬容以本號為尚書令，吏部尚書張續為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: He Jingrong, General of the Central Authority and Governor of Danyang, with his existing title was made Director of the Secretariat; Zhang Xu, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He Jingrong, General of the Central Authority and Governor of Danyang, was appointed Director of the Secretariat under his existing title; Zhang Xu, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，御史中丞、參禮儀事賀琛奏：「今南北二郊及藉田往還，並宜禦輦，不復乘路。

translations.literal: On dingsi, He Chen, Imperial Censor and participant in ritual affairs, memorialized: "For the southern and northern suburbs and the going and returning from the ceremonial field, all should use the imperial carriage; no longer ride the road carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi He Chen, Imperial Censor and participant in ritual affairs, memorialized: "For the southern and northern suburbs and the going and returning from the ceremonial field, the Emperor should ride the imperial carriage rather than the road carriage.

sentences.zh: 二郊請用素輦，藉田往還乘常輦，皆以侍中倍乘。

translations.literal: For the two suburbs please use the plain carriage; for going and returning from the ceremonial field use the regular carriage — both with the Attendant as double rider.
translations.idiomatic: For the two suburbs let the plain carriage be used; for going and returning from the ceremonial field let the regular carriage be used — both with the Attendant riding double.

sentences.zh: 停大將軍及太僕。

translations.literal: Suspend the Grand General and the Master of the Horse.
translations.idiomatic: Suspend the Grand General and the Master of the Horse from the procession.

sentences.zh: 」詔付尚書博議施行。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the Secretariat to discuss broadly and implement.
translations.idiomatic: "An edict ordered the Secretariat to discuss the proposal broadly and implement it.

sentences.zh: 改素輦名大同輦。

translations.literal: The plain carriage's name was changed to Datong Carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The plain carriage was renamed the Datong Carriage.

sentences.zh: 郊祀宗廟乘玉輦。

translations.literal: For suburban sacrifice and ancestral temple rites the jade carriage was used.
translations.idiomatic: For suburban sacrifice and ancestral temple rites the jade carriage was used.

sentences.zh: 辛未，祀南郊，詔孝悌力田及州閭鄉党稱為善人者，各賜爵一級。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the southern suburb was sacrificed to; an edict: filial sons, obedient younger brothers, strong farmers, and those in provinces, districts, townships, and hamlets called good men were each granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the court sacrificed at the southern suburb; an edict granted one rank of nobility each to filial sons, obedient younger brothers, strong farmers, and those in provinces, districts, townships, and hamlets called good men.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙酉，扶南國獻生犀。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn on yiyou, Funan presented a live rhinoceros.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn Funan presented a live rhinoceros.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙亥，東魏人來聘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter on yihai, men of Eastern Wei came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter envoys from Eastern Wei arrived on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 十二月，使兼散騎常侍柳豹聘於東魏。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Acting Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Bao was sent on a friendly mission to Eastern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Acting Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Liu Bao was sent on a friendly mission to Eastern Wei.

sentences.zh: 是歲，都下訛言天子取人肝以飴天狗，大小相警，日晚便閉門持仗，數月乃止。

translations.literal: This year, a false rumor in the capital said the Son of Heaven took people's livers to feed the celestial dog; great and small warned one another; at evening they closed doors and took up weapons — for several months before it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: That year a false rumor spread in the capital that the Son of Heaven took people's livers to feed the celestial dog; great and small warned one another, and each evening they barred their doors and took up weapons — for several months before the panic subsided.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月庚戌朔，曲赦司、豫、徐、兗四州。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year on gengxu, the first day of the month, a partial amnesty for the four provinces of Si, Yu, Xu, and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on gengxu, the first day of the month, a partial amnesty was declared for Si, Yu, Xu, and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，耕藉田。

translations.literal: In the second month on jihai, the ceremonial field was plowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai, the ceremonial field was plowed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，詔晉、宋、齊三代諸陵有職司者，勤加守護。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on guiwei, an edict: the tombs of Jin, Song, and Qi of the three dynasties with responsible officials were to be diligently guarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guiwei, an edict ordered diligent guarding of the tombs of Jin, Song, and Qi of the three dynasties wherever responsible officials were assigned.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，河南王遣使朝，獻馬及方物，求釋迦像並經論十四條。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on jimao, the Prince of Henan sent envoys on a visit, presenting horses and local products, requesting a Shakyamuni image and fourteen items of sutras and treatises.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, the Prince of Henan sent envoys presenting horses and local products and requesting a Shakyamuni image and fourteen items of sutras and treatises.

sentences.zh: 敕付像並制旨涅盤、般若、金光明講疏一百三卷。

translations.literal: An imperial command delivered the image and one hundred three fascicles of imperially composed lecture commentaries on the Nirvana, Prajna, and Golden Light, with exegesis.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial command delivered the image and one hundred three fascicles of the Emperor's lecture commentaries on the Nirvana, Prajna, and Golden Light sutras.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，東魏人來聘。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on dinghai, men of Eastern Wei came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn envoys from Eastern Wei arrived on a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 遣散騎常侍陸晏子報聘。

translations.literal: Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Lu Yanzi was sent on a return mission.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Lu Yanzi was sent on a return mission.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on wuwu, a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuwu, a general amnesty was declared.

sentences.zh: 辛未，盤盤國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Panpan sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Panpan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌，司空袁昂薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on wuxu, Minister of Works Yuan Ang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuxu, Minister of Works Yuan Ang died.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己卯，曲赦都下。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter on jimao, a partial amnesty for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jimao, a partial amnesty was declared for the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，江州刺史豫章王歡薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on renzi, Prince of Yuzhang Huan, Governor of Jiang Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renzi, Prince of Yuzhang Huan, Governor of Jiang Province, died.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月辛巳，祀南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the seventh year on xinsi, the southern suburb was sacrificed to; a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the seventh year, on xinsi in the first month, the court sacrificed at the southern suburb and declared a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，祀明堂。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Bright Hall was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the court sacrificed at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，以行宕昌王梁彌泰為平西將軍、河涼二州刺史，正封宕昌王。

translations.literal: In the second month on yisi, Liang Mitai, Acting Prince of Dangchang, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of the two provinces of He and Liang, and formally enfeoffed as Prince of Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi, Liang Mitai, Acting Prince of Dangchang, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of He and Liang provinces, and formally enfeoffed as Prince of Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，耕藉田。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the ceremonial field was plowed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the ceremonial field was plowed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，都下地震。

translations.literal: On yimao, the capital shook with an earthquake.
